correctness.rationale: The exact birth-death Moran transient generator has 2^n-2 configuration states with self-loops. For fixation indicator moments h,a,z, the identities (I-Q)h=b,(I-Q)a=h,(I-Q)z=2a-h are correct. I independently built all 14 transient diamond configurations with Fraction arithmetic, solved the three systems and found mean-degree3 minus degree2 = -3095643/121414228 and variance difference = +4612716655893867/14741414760835984 at r=5, including all four seed orbit values. All connected graphs of order <=3 are K2, K3 and P3; K2/K3 are vertex-transitive and the displayed rational P3 gaps center minus leaf are -3/(2r+1) and -6(r+2)/(2r+1)^2 for r>0. Thus four is the minimal n with disjoint minimizing sets.
residual_risks: Limited to successful fixation conditioning, birth-death update, simple connected undirected unweighted graphs, specific r=5 witness.

value.rationale: Mean conditional fixation time and its variance measure different seed-selection risks; identifying their first possible disagreement at exactly four graph sites is a motivated sharp structural boundary. The diamond witness is a natural small graph and the strict, all-fitness exclusion for n<=3 makes this more than a one-off numerical anomaly.
